content.name: Megan Kowalczyk
content.title: Senior Accountant, CPA
content.summary: Colorado-licensed CPA with eight years across public accounting, distribution and healthcare SaaS. Owns the month-end close and revenue recognition for a $64M subscription business and cut the close from nine business days to five without adding headcount.

experience.title: Senior Accountant
bullets: Rebuilt the month-end close checklist in NetSuite and FloQast, shortening the close from 9 to 5 business days within three quarters.
Own ASC 606 revenue schedules for 1,400 multi-year SaaS contracts, including implementation fees and mid-term upgrades.
Prepared the audit PBC list and walkthrough support for the company's first full-scope financial statement audit, which closed with zero adjustments booked.
Coach two staff accountants on reconciliations and journal entry support; both now close their assigned accounts without review notes.

experience.title: Senior Accountant
bullets: Reconciled inventory across three warehouses each month, tracing a recurring $180K variance to a pricing table error in the ERP.
Calculated and booked monthly accruals for supplier rebates worth about $2.3M a year, replacing a spreadsheet that missed late claims.
Took over sales and use tax filings in four states and resolved a backlog of 11 notices with no penalties paid.
Built a fixed asset roll-forward for 260 delivery vehicles and coolers that the external auditors adopted as their lead schedule.

experience.title: Staff Accountant, Audit and Assurance
bullets: Performed fieldwork on 14 audit and review engagements for nonprofits, construction contractors and dental practices.
Drafted financial statements and footnotes for clients with revenue from $3M to $40M.
Tested payroll and cash disbursement controls, documenting findings that led three clients to add dual approval on wires.

education.details: 150 credit hours completed for CPA licensure; Beta Alpha Psi member

achievements.title: Close time cut by 44%
achievements.detail: Took the monthly close from 9 to 5 business days at Larkspur Health Software.

achievements.title: Clean first audit
achievements.detail: No audit adjustments in the company's first full-scope financial statement audit.
